sql_fato: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE fato_item_venda AS SELECT i.order_id, i.order_item_id, i.product_id, i.seller_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, o.order_status, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS data_compra, CAST(date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS DATE) AS mes, c.customer_state AS estado_cliente, c.customer_city AS cidade_cliente, p.product_category_name AS categoria_original, t.product_category_name_english AS categoria_ingles, coalesce(p.product_category_name, '(sem categoria)') AS categoria, i.price, i.freight_value FROM olist_order_items AS i LEFT JOIN olist_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id LEFT JOIN olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN olist_products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
sql_mart: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mart_vendas_mensais AS SELECT mes, estado_cliente, categoria, sum(CAST(price AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS receita_produtos, sum(CAST(freight_value AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS frete, count(*) AS itens FROM fato_item_venda GROUP BY mes, estado_cliente, categoria
